The '''Battle of Bannistar Station''' was one of the first engagements of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nantz]] was given command of the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]], tasked with operations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. He staged his campaign from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] after the end of the [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

A [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]], with [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] operations overseen by [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], struck [[Bannistar Station]], capturing the Imperial installation following a heavy bombardment.<ref name="TEGTW" />
